title: Implementation of 24P, 25P and 30P Segmented Frames for 1920 x 1080 Production Format
scope: This practice defines the changes to SMPTE 274M to implement various 1920 × 1080 progressive systems in their segmented frame format: 24sF, 25sF, and 30sF. Only the changes to the appropriate clauses of SMPTE 274M are contained herein. The same clause, table, and figure numbering system, as used in SMPTE 274M, is employed in this practice.
